title: steamwebapi
description: Live Steam Market API docs, schemas, products, games, markets and endpoint search.
summary: Live Steam Market API docs, schemas, products, games, markets and endpoint search.
offersHint: Live Steam Market API docs, schemas, products, games, markets and endpoint search. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.steamwebapi.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_endpoints
toolsPreview.description: Fuzzy text search across all steamwebapi.com OpenAPI endpoints and Steam domain concepts (assetid, doppler phase, market_hash_name, etc.). Returns ranked hits with path, method, tag and summary.

toolsPreview.name: get_endpoint
toolsPreview.description: Returns the full OpenAPI operation object for a given path: parameters, request body, all response schemas, examples, and tags. Use after search_endpoints to drill into a specific endpoint.

toolsPreview.name: list_endpoints
toolsPreview.description: Lists all steamwebapi.com endpoints (path + method + summary), optionally filtered by tag. Useful for quickly enumerating what is available.

toolsPreview.name: list_games
toolsPreview.description: Lists every game supported by steamwebapi.com with its slug, name, Steam appId, and the value to pass as `game=` in API queries.

toolsPreview.name: list_markets
toolsPreview.description: Lists every third-party marketplace covered by the steamwebapi.com market price endpoints, with their domain and the games they cover.

toolsPreview.name: list_products
toolsPreview.description: Lists steamwebapi.com product packages (Price API, Inventory API, Float API, ...) with the endpoints each one bundles. Use get_pricing for paid plans, request quotas and upgrade guidance.

toolsPreview.name: get_concept
toolsPreview.description: Returns a detailed explanation for a Steam / steamwebapi concept (identifiers, CS2 mechanics, pricing fields, inventory flags). Built from curated domain knowledge specific to this platform.

toolsPreview.name: list_concepts
toolsPreview.description: Lists every curated concept exposed by get_concept, optionally filtered by category. Use to discover what domain explanations are available.

toolsPreview.name: get_pricing
toolsPreview.description: Returns public steamwebapi pricing plans, per-endpoint rate limits, API-key location, quota guidance and a recommended plan for the requested use case. Does not perform checkout or account actions.

toolsPreview.name: call_readonly_endpoint
toolsPreview.description: Executes a documented steamwebapi GET endpoint with the caller API key from the MCP Authorization or X-Api-Key header. Refuses POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE plus Proxy, Steam Guard and Tradeoffer endpoints.
